3510-3875-5929-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3510-3875-5929-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

647-751-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

17-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
17-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lava Zombie by paying its mana cost.
When Lava Zombie enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2724-4499-8172.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

1395-5078-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1420-2178-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-6797.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-6720--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-6720--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2557-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-2557-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3484-5391-7803-7824.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three energy counters.
Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3484-5391-7803-7824.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

261-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2946-4871-5686-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5686-6026.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6139.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

593-1203.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
593-1203.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

957-2334-7722.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn
Blink Thor using Soulherder.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-5256-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

339-677-2921-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5147-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3967-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3062-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Pir.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3062-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

3000-5670-6752.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6752.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel and Thopter enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1651-2797-5390-6311.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other artifacts.
1651-2797-5390-6311.description:
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing two other artifacts, adding {6}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Radiant Lotus.
Repeat.

997-1789-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
997-1789-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2440-3562-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-3562-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the token Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sky Hussar.
Repeat.

2201-2558-2829-5687.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1719-2085-4639.notablePrerequisites: Kelpie Guide and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1719-2085-4639.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

188-224-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Lavamancer's Skill attached to Avenging Druid.
188-224-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

1987-4377-4423-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-4477.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

940-2178-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
940-2178-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

802-864-1671-3400-3620.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached by tapping them, adding {2}{G}{U}.
Resolve Snap, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and the land with Gift of Paradise attached.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3175-4681-4812.description:
Cast Sun Titan.
Sun Titan enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
With the Animate Dead trigger on the stack, Activate Ashnod's Altar, sacrificing Sun Titan to add {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, causing it to become an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead" and returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead is put into your graveyard due to state based actions, as it cannot attach to a creature with protection from black.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield triggers.
Resolve Karmic Guide's enter the battlefield trigger returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

395-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper and Hanna do not have summoning sickness.
395-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hanna by paying {1}{W}{U} and tapping them, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.
